run_gold_training: run full training of the GOLD model with a student and teacher model on a dataset
run_gold_training_lora: run GOLD training with LoRA fine-tuning using PEFT for parameter-efficient training
run_gold_training_uld: run GOLD training with Universal Logit Distillation loss instead of Jensen-Shannon divergence
run_gold_training_vllm: run GOLD training with vLLM for fast student model completion generation
run_gold_training_seq_kd: run GOLD training with Sequence-Level Knowledge Distinction on teacher-generated output
